Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #404 · 2026-10-27T00:47Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #404 as item 2 of 4. Seat increment (re-read 2026-10-27T00:47Z; the card is not restated):
- P1 holds: 26 open `priority:p1` cards in this repo. P2 has moved since filing: #26304 and #26314 are **closed** (landed), so the only live app-driven p1s are the two skills halves #26347 and #26362, both `pm:blocked` behind their code cards. The release card #25807 names neither. The live cost of letter A today is therefore two skills cards in the p1 pool, not four.
- Half-state read, not written: `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` together; the second leaves in the ruling's stroke.
- Facets (the card's block, re-read): ① A keeps one closed rule ("a protocol addition is p1"); 甲 adds two judgement arms (app-driven; release-named or go-live-blocked) that triage decides card by card; ② the p1 pool is not crowding the 18.2 release today; ③ A needs no source judgement, 甲 can be misjudged; ④ none of the three adds a gate or script.
- The seat agrees with **A** for now, with the card's re-raise condition kept: triage re-raises 甲 with the count when the p1 pool outgrows the release's capacity. Not 甲 today (its only effect would be relabelling two blocked skills cards) and not C (drops the rule the maintainer set). Workload: none.
Prior rulings read: 「协议新增定 p1，其余 p2」 · 「发版本优先的都p1」 → the triage seat thread #6015, no card; ADR none; thread: #6015.

Ruling: batch #404 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-27T00:55Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #404 with 「同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6430906534. Letter **A**: the triage yardstick stands as the maintainer set it — 「协议新增定 p1，其余 p2」 and 「发版本优先的都p1」 — for every protocol addition, app-driven or not. The card's re-raise condition is kept: when the open p1 pool outgrows the release's capacity, triage re-raises 甲 on a new card with the count. Not 甲 today (its only live effect would be relabelling the two blocked skills halves #26347 / #26362; #26304 and #26314 have already landed) and not C.

Workload of the chosen letter: none. The triage seat records the ruling on #6015 and applies it on its next round.

Execution: no carrier work remains, so this card closes `completed` in this act; `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` leave in the same stroke. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment.

Closed `completed` by the director seat · 2026-10-27T01:02Z

Ruled A by the maintainer (ruling 6431014712, 「同意」 to batch #404): the triage yardstick stands — every protocol addition is p1, 「发版本优先的都p1」 unchanged.
